profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
As a Senior Software Engineer with a proven track record in developing and maintaining dynamic web applications, I am passionate about leveraging my diverse technical skills to drive innovation and deliver impactful solutions. My extensive background in both software development and testing highlights a versatile skill set across various programming languages and technologies.

At Raymond James, I led the development of responsive web applications using Angular, integrated RESTful APIs, and automated build processes with Jenkins, resulting in enhanced performance and accelerated deployment. My role also involved mentoring junior developers and overseeing Angular projects, showcasing my leadership and team guidance capabilities.

During my tenure at FIS, I focused on enriching client functionalities through Angular components, C.R.U.D. APIs, and third-party integrations. I played a pivotal role in transitioning teams from Waterfall to Agile methodologies, optimizing application performance, and demonstrating my adaptability and commitment to continuous improvement.

My technical expertise spans a wide range of tools and methodologies, including:

Frontend Technologies: Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, JSON, RxJS, NgRx, REST
Backend & Middleware: Java, C#, NodeJS, .NET Core, .NET Framework
UI/UX Libraries & Tools: Angular Material, Ag-Grid, Bootstrap, Jasmine, Karma
Development Tools: WebStorm, IntelliJ, Visual Studio, Git, SVN, Postman, Jenkins, Azure, JIRA, Bitbucket, TFS, VMware
Databases: MS SQL Server, MySQL, Oracle DBA, PostgreSQL
Methodologies: Agile, Scrum, CI/CD, DevOps, Automated Testing

With a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science and certifications such as Become an Angular Developer and SAFe Practitioner, I am dedicated to driving project success and delivering high-quality products. If you’re seeking a committed professional with a proven ability to master new technologies and elevate team performance, let’s connect!

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Charlotte, North Carolina, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: St. Petersburg, Florida, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Developed and maintained Angular (version 12/13)  applications with strong skills in RxJS for reactive programming and NgRx for state management, implementing a single store approach using Redux (NgRx) to manage complex application states.
- Designed and implemented scalable Angular solutions focused on modularity, reusability, and performance optimization, leveraging components, templates, and dependency injection.
- Integrated RESTful APIs with Angular services to ensure efficient data flow and robust application functionality, enhancing system performance and reliability.
- Utilized JSON for data exchange and transformation, ensuring seamless integration and compatibility with external systems, and supporting smooth data flows.
- Employed advanced data grid functionalities using Ag-Grid, including sorting, filtering, and pagination, to enhance data presentation and user interactions.
- Optimized application performance by implementing lazy loading of Angular modules and code splitting, significantly reducing initial load times and improving user experience.
- Designed and implemented auth guards for managing user authentication and authorization, securing routes, and protecting sensitive application access.
- Automated CI/CD pipelines with Angular CLI and Jenkins, streamlining deployment processes, accelerating feature releases, and enhancing development efficiency.
- Led code reviews and mentored junior developers, enforcing Angular best practices, resulting in a 20% reduction in bugs and enhanced application stability.
- Actively participated in Agile methodologies and Scrum practices, using JIRA for issue tracking and project management, ensuring continuous improvement and alignment with project objectives.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed Angular (version 10/11) components and services focused on application development, user experience, and integration with Ag-Grid for advanced data functionalities.
- Applied solution design principles using Angular Material and NgRx, supporting modularity, maintainability, and efficient data management in complex applications.
- Created and updated C.R.U.D. APIs, integrating them with Angular services for client-specific customizations and seamless data handling.
- Designed and maintained backend services using Java, C#, and .NET Core, ensuring comprehensive integration with Angular components.
- Developed and optimized dynamic forms using Angular's reactive forms, ensuring robust data validation and seamless integration with backend APIs.
- Utilized SQL Server, SQL Developer, and XML for database management and data exchange, optimizing SQL queries and ensuring data integrity.
- Resolved technical issues related to Angular components and services, demonstrating strong analytical thinking, risk management, and familiarity with XML.
- Led the transition from Waterfall to Agile methodologies, enhancing project management practices, team collaboration, and productivity.
- Actively participated in Agile software development frameworks and Scrum principles, contributing to continuous process improvement and project success.
- Experienced with JIRA for issue management, effectively tracking tasks, bugs, and project progress as a developer.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
- Conducted comprehensive testing, including functional, regression, and end-to-end, to ensure high-quality software delivery and performance.
- Developed and executed detailed test cases to validate application functionality and identify defects early in the development lifecycle.
- Enhanced automation testing capabilities using BDD frameworks with Selenium and Cucumber, streamlining test execution and reporting.
- Utilized SQL for backend testing, ensuring data accuracy and integrity within databases, and verifying data management processes.
- Collaborated with development teams to troubleshoot and resolve issues, contributing to overall project success and product quality.

positions.title: Technology Analyst Intern
positions.description:
- Assisted in designing and implementing AML-focused dashboards in MicroStrategy, improving data visualization and supporting compliance decision-making processes.
- Developed dynamic and static dashboards to meet AML compliance requirements, enhancing data accessibility for AML investigators and end-users.
- Gained exposure to SAS programming, contributing to AML data extraction and quality checks, ensuring accurate and reliable data for investigations and reporting.
- Contributed to data management efforts in AML projects, supporting technical strategy development and ensuring data accuracy across multiple AML-related initiatives.
- Shared insights on MicroStrategy functionalities with AML team members, enhancing overall efficiency and effective use of the software in AML investigations.

positions.title: Assistant Manager
positions.description:
- Supervised daily operations, ensuring compliance with company policies and food safety standards to maintain a high-quality dining experience.
- Managed staff scheduling, payroll, and performance evaluations, leading to improved team productivity and morale.
- Analyzed sales data and implemented strategic marketing initiatives, driving a 10% increase in store revenue.
- Handled inventory management, reducing waste by 15% through effective stock rotation and accurate order forecasting.
- Resolved customer complaints and conflicts efficiently, enhancing customer satisfaction and fostering loyalty.

volunteerExperiences.description:

- Collaborated with team members to manage logistics and scheduling, maintaining an efficient and consistent workflow for all services.
- Played a key role in organizing and supporting special programs and events, boosting community engagement and participation.
- Facilitated clear and effective communication between staff, volunteers, and attendees, creating a welcoming and organized atmosphere during services and events.
- Contributed to the development of new initiatives, helping to expand the church's outreach and strengthen community connections.

- Optimized database queries, reducing web application load times by 40% and significantly enhancing user experience.
- Conducted thorough code reviews, ensuring adherence to best practices and promoting a clean, maintainable, and scalable codebase.
- Coordinated with team members to troubleshoot issues, resulting in a 30% reduction in bug-related delays and smoother project delivery.

- Conducted usability testing and gathered user feedback, iterating on designs to improve web application functionality and user satisfaction.
- Streamlined development processes by introducing best practices, reducing development time by 20% and improving overall project delivery.
